facts: The Java launcher requires JDK 17 or newer; Java 17, 21, and 25 are documented as supported targets.
scip-java index supports Maven and Gradle; its Maven default is --batch-mode clean verify -DskipTests.
The Java indexer is a compiler plugin that runs during regular project compilation.
The documented Docker image includes Java 17, 21, and 25, is a large download, and downloads all external dependencies of the indexed codebase on every invocation.
The indexing command may have build side effects, including cleaning the compile cache.
Manual setup adds the scip compiler plugin to the Maven compiler plugin and requires compiling the codebase to emit per-file SCIP shards.
The official release page showed v0.13.1; this version was not installed or executed locally.
The registered D05 root POM is a seven-module Maven reactor, including test-jpms, test-graal-native-image, and test-shrinker.
The official GitHub release page showed v0.13.1 as Latest on 2026-10-06.
The official release API published SHA-256 asset digests for the launcher and checksum sidecar.
